name: Winsome Breweries Limited
about: Winsome Breweries Limited manufactures and sells beer in India. It operates in three segments: Beer, Educational training, and Investment. The company also provides educational training services under the Deen Dayal Upadhyay Gramin Kaushal Yojana (DDU-GKY) of the central and state governments, as well as investment services. Winsome Breweries Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in New Delhi, India.
